title: The request to start an experiment

sandboxVersion.description: The id of an image version (protocol/sandbox/v1 version), or the newest ready version of the sandbox of the run.

sandbox.description: The sandbox of the run: the name of its ratel.yaml. Absent: the sandbox of the evals named, else of the newest ready version.

trials.description: The trials for each case. Absent: the trials of each eval (3 unless the eval sets another).

params.description: The parameter values that each run gets: a flat object of the parameters that ratel.yaml declares.

label.description: Run only the cases with this label.

evals.description: The names of the evals to run, from 1 to 100. Absent: the suite, each eval of the sandbox. An unknown name is refused with not_found (404).
